title: Customer Support Reply
description: Draft an empathetic, policy-accurate reply to a customer support inquiry with clear guardrails.

variables.name: customer_message
variables.description: The incoming message or complaint from the customer
variables.example: My order #1042 was supposed to arrive two days ago for my daughter's birthday. Tracking has not updated, and I'm very frustrated.

variables.name: relevant_policy
variables.description: The exact company policy terms governing this situation
variables.example: Shipments delayed more than 48 hours past the estimated delivery window qualify for a full refund of shipping charges. Standard replacement orders can be dispatched if tracking shows no movement for 5 consecutive business days.

variables.name: brand_voice
variables.description: The desired tone and style of communication

variables.name: resolution_offered
variables.description: The specific resolution or next steps provided to the customer
variables.example: Apologize sincerely, refund the express shipping fee, and initiate a carrier investigation to expedite package status.
